name: Valley of Love
kicker: Landscaped valley park north of town
summary: Stroll the landscaped paths and flower slopes of a paid park in the hills north of the centre. It suits families and photo stops more than hikers. Plan 1 to 2 hours.
heroCaption: Flower slopes in the Valley of Love

notice.title: This is a paid park
notice.body: The valley is landscaped and fenced, with a ticket at the gate. For open mountain views, Lang Biang is the half-day.

body: The park north of town is a landscaped valley: paths, planted slopes, and a managed walk. Plan 1 to 2 hours.
Come for the flower beds and the photo spots. If you want a mountain view, Lang Biang is the better half-day.

figures.caption: The stone name slope in the park
figures.alt: Stone slope with the park name at the Valley of Love

gettingThere: The park is north of the centre. Take a taxi from Xuan Huong Lake.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. A 2025 secondary article prints about 250,000 VND. Hours about 07:00–17:00 (Visit Lâm Đồng).
